prompt: People today buy more things than they need. Why is this happening, and is it a positive or negative development?
essay:
Nowadays, a new topic has arisen in our society: people today buy more things than they need. Why is this happening, and is it a positive or negative development? This happens because of advertising and the availability of a wide range of products in one place. Indeed, it is a negative development for our budget because it wastes our money.

To begin with, people buy more items than they need. This is because of future needs, a high budget and diverse products. So, it is a negative development in our lives because it drains our emergency budget. For example, last week I went to the mall to pass the time. I found myself buying a laptop, but I already had one. All of that happened because of the discounts and advertising. Therefore, I suggest setting a budget and writing everything down on paper before I buy something.

Another important point is that this happened because of misuse and a lack of awareness of financial difficulties. In other words, people who are careless about their budget will suddenly go broke in future. For instance, last year, one of my friends bought a lot of food items without realising he had spent his budget for two months, so he needed to take a loan from a bank. As a result, everyone should have a clear vision of what they want to avoid negative effects.

In conclusion, both points show us how to deal with and understand what we have and what we need to avoid negative effects. Therefore, I believe everyone should clearly understand their expenses and requirements, including monthly and yearly obligations.
